# ColabWatch **Zero-UI, zero-idle-overhead priority-queue watcher for official Google Colab CLI runtimes — rejects silent GPU downgrades instantly, guards Compute Units, and alerts on handover.** [![CI](https://img.shields.io/github/actions/workflow/status/KennyMcSimpson/ColabWatch/ci.yml?branch=main&style=flat-square&label=CI)](https://github.com/KennyMcSimpson/ColabWatch/actions/workflows/ci.yml) [![Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/version-0.1.0-f59e0b?style=flat-square)](CHANGELOG.md) [![Node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%3E%3D20-16a34a?style=flat-square)](package.json) [![Zero JS Dependencies](https://img.shields.io/badge/js%20dependencies-0-10b981?style=flat-square)](package.json) [![Tests](https://img.shields.io/badge/tests-15%2F15%20passing-10b981?style=flat-square)](test/colab-watch.test.mjs) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-64748b?style=flat-square)](LICENSE) [Why ColabWatch](#why-colabwatch) · [30-Second Quick Start](#30-second-quick-start) · [Why Not Loop `colab new`](#why-not-just-loop-colab-new) · [Priority & Handover](#priority-modes--mode-a-handover) · [Antigravity Plugin](#antigravity-zero-daemon-plugin) · [CLI Reference](#cli-reference) · [Safety](#safety--responsible-use)
--- ## Why ColabWatch High-tier Google Colab accelerators (`G4` RTX PRO 6000 96GB, `H100`, `A100`) fluctuate continuously across capacity windows. Waiting manually wastes hours, while naive retry scripts silently accept downgraded T4 VMs, corrupt `sessions.json`, or hammer your account into `429` cooldowns. **ColabWatch** pairs a zero-dependency Node.js ESM controller with a thin Python bridge directly over your locally authorized official `google-colab-cli` environment — **no browser automation, no MCP server, no lifecycle hooks, and zero idle token tax**. | Pain Point | Manual / Naive Scripts | ColabWatch (`0` idle processes) | |---|---|---| | **Silent GPU downgrade** | `colab new --gpu G4` ignores the real granted GPU and saves `"G4"` for a T4 | Verifies granted hardware via `colab_cli.client.Client`; immediately calls `unassign()` on mismatch with **zero `sessions.json` pollution** | | **Priority fallback** | Manual re-runs for each GPU tier | Priority list (`G4,A100,L4`) with optional `--hold-top ` progressive tier unlocking | | **Rate-limit & auth safety** | Tight loops trip `429`; expired OAuth blocks on `input()` | Hard `>=15s` floor + `±20%` jitter, `>=300s` `429` cooldown (`3x` breaker), non-interactive keyring check, instant stop on Auth / CAPTCHA | | **Compute Unit protection** | Accidental double sessions or overnight idle burn | Pre-checks active sessions & `--min-cu` balance floor; optional opt-in `--auto-release-after` with conservative activity check | | **Agent / Editor overhead** | Always-on sidecars or global MCP servers | Pure Antigravity Skill + CLI (`/colab-watch`), `0` hooks, `0` MCP servers, `0` background processes when idle |

--- ## 30-Second Quick Start ### Prerequisites - **Node.js `>= 20.0.0`** (zero `npm install` runtime dependencies) - Official **`google-colab-cli`** installed and authenticated in a local Python virtual environment (credentials already stored in your OS keyring) ### Run Immediately ```bash # 1. Verify Python bridge, official colab-cli keyring state, and local config node bin/colab-watch.mjs doctor # 2. Read-only account probe (0 Compute Units consumed): CU balance, eligible GPUs, active sessions node bin/colab-watch.mjs probe # 3. Start priority-queue watcher in background (Mode-A handover) node bin/colab-watch.mjs start --gpus G4,A100,L4 --session pro6000 # 4. Monitor progress, inspect bounded logs, claim handover, or stop cleanly node bin/colab-watch.mjs status node bin/colab-watch.mjs logs --lines 40 node bin/colab-watch.mjs claim node bin/colab-watch.mjs stop ```
Sample Read-Only Probe & Status Output ```text ColabWatch Read-Only Probe (0 CU): Balance : 73.14 CU (rate: 0 CU/h) Eligible GPUs : G4, A100, L4, T4 Active Sessions: None ColabWatch Status: ACQUIRED (NOT RUNNING) Priority : G4 > A100 > L4 | Session: pro6000 Progress : round=3, attempts=4, downgradesRejected=1, 412=2, 429=0 CU : 73.14 Event : Acquired G4 (RTX PRO 6000 96GB) as session "pro6000" Acquired : G4 (RTX PRO 6000 96GB) as "pro6000" URL : https://colab.research.google.com/notebooks/empty.ipynb?dbu=%2Ftun%2Fm%2Fm-s-... ```
Once acquired, the session is atomically registered inside official `colab-cli`'s `sessions.json` (`filelock` protected), so you can immediately attach from any terminal or coding agent: ```bash colab exec -s pro6000 -f train.py colab url -s pro6000 colab stop -s pro6000 ``` --- ## Why Not Just Loop `colab new`? Calling `colab new --gpu G4` in a shell loop looks tempting, but inspecting `google-colab-cli` reveals several critical failure modes for unattended operation:

1. **Silent Downgrade Blind Spot**: `colab new` writes the *requested* accelerator string into `sessions.json` without verifying `PostAssignmentResponse.accelerator`. ColabWatch calls `colab_cli.client.Client.assign()` directly (with internal retries disabled via `COLAB_CLI_ASSIGN_RETRIES=0`), inspects the actual granted hardware (including `list_assignments()` fallback if an `Assignment` object is returned), and immediately calls `unassign()` with retry on any mismatch without touching `sessions.json`. 2. **Orphan VM Protection**: Any post-`assign()` parsing or verification exception triggers automatic `unassign()` cleanup; if saving `sessions.json` fails *after* a valid target GPU is allocated, ColabWatch surfaces `STATE_SAVE_FAILED_VM_LIVE` with the exact `endpoint` and `connectUrl` plus a high-priority alert instead of silently crashing and abandoning a live billing VM. 3. **Non-Interactive Auth**: Instead of falling into `input("Enter the authorization code: ")` when OAuth tokens expire, `scripts/colab_bridge.py` reads the OS keyring directly, refreshes silently when possible, and immediately stops with `BLOCKED_AUTH` otherwise. --- ## Priority Modes & Mode-A Handover ### Priority Scheduling - **Immediate Scan (default `--hold-top 0`)**: Each round checks your priority list in strict order (e.g. `G4` -> `A100` -> `L4`, spaced by `--step-delay 3s`) and locks the highest-priority genuine GPU available. Accelerators explicitly absent from your account's `eligibleGpus` or rejected with HTTP `400` are skipped automatically. - **Progressive Hold (`--hold-top 20`)**: Stays strictly on tier 1 (`G4`) for the first 20 minutes before unlocking tier 2 (`A100`), and another 20 minutes before unlocking tier 3 (`L4`). ### Mode-A Handover (Zero-Surprise-Kill Default) - **Default (`--auto-release-after 0`)**: Upon acquiring a verified target GPU, ColabWatch persists `state.json`, registers the session in `sessions.json`, sends a non-blocking Windows WinRT Toast notification (with audio), prints the offline browser `connectUrl` and `colab` commands, and exits cleanly. **It never terminates an acquired VM behind your back.** - **Opt-in Idle Guard (`--auto-release-after 45`)**: For overnight runs, explicitly specify an idle timeout in minutes. After acquisition, the watcher enters `ACQUIRED_GUARDING`: - Run `colab-watch claim` (or start using the session via `colab exec`) -> transitions to `HANDED_OVER` and exits without touching the VM. - Unclaimed past the deadline -> verifies local session activity first (never blindly kills if activity verification fails!), then safely releases only the matching `endpoint` and notifies you honestly (`AUTO_RELEASED_IDLE` or `AUTO_RELEASE_FAILED`). --- ## Antigravity Zero-Daemon Plugin ColabWatch ships as a native zero-daemon **Google Antigravity** plugin (`plugin.json` + `skills/colab-watch/SKILL.md` + `assets/logo.svg`, zero `hooks.json`, zero `mcp_config.json`): ```bash node bin/colab-watch.mjs --install-ag \ --colab-python "/path/to/colab-cli/.venv/Scripts/python.exe" \ --data-dir "/path/to/ColabWatch/.local-data" \ --json ``` - Pure-copy deployment (`0` symlinks/junctions, byte-verified per file, `touchedHostConfigJson: false`) - Machine-specific paths live solely in git-ignored `.local-config.json` - Exposes a single clean slash command: **`/colab-watch`** --- ## CLI Reference | Command | Description | |---|---| | `doctor [--json]` | Check plugin manifest, configured Python `.venv`, keyring OAuth status (redacted), and watcher liveness | | `probe [--json]` | Read-only check of Compute Units balance, hourly rate, `eligibleGpus`/`eligibleTpus`, and active sessions (`0 CU`) | | `start [options]` | Run synchronous preflight, then launch singleton detached background watcher (or `--foreground`) | | `status [--json]` | Inspect live watcher state, round/attempt counts, downgrades rejected, CU balance, `connectUrl`, and handover commands | | `logs [--lines N]` | Read tail (`1..500`) across bounded 2-slot rotating logs (`watch.log` + `watch.prev.log`) | | `claim [--json]` | Acknowledge handover during `ACQUIRED_GUARDING` and disarm opt-in auto-release | | `stop [--json]` | Gracefully signal watcher to exit after finishing any in-flight API call (prevents orphan VMs) | | `release --session --confirm` | Explicitly unassign a remote runtime and remove matching local `sessions.json` entry | | `--install-ag [options]` | Pure-copy install into `~/.gemini/config/plugins/colab-watch` with strict preflight & Windows path defenses |
All start Options & Hard Safety Limits | Flag | Default | Bounds / Notes | |---|---|---| | `--gpus ` | `G4,H100,A100` | Comma/`>`-separated priority order from `G4, H100, A100, L4, T4, V6E1, V5E1` | | `--session ` | `pro6000` | `[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]{0,63}`; auto-suffixed if another live remote VM owns that name | | `--interval ` | `45` | Hard floor `15s`, ceiling `600s` (`±20%` jitter; gentle `1.5x` relaxation after 10 empty rounds) | | `--step-delay ` | `3` | Hard floor `2s`, ceiling `60s` between distinct GPUs in one scan round | | `--hold-top ` | `0` | `0..720` min per top tier before unlocking next candidate (`0` = scan all each round) | | `--max-wait ` | `240` | `1..720` min hard total wait cap | | `--min-cu ` | `5` | Minimum CU balance floor required to poll (`0` disables floor) | | `--high-mem` | `false` | Request High-RAM shape where supported | | `--allow-existing` | `false` | Permit watching while another assignment is active (never hijacks pre-existing endpoints) | | `--auto-release-after ` | `0` | `0..240` min opt-in idle guard after acquisition (`0` = off) | | `--no-notify` | `false` | Disable Windows desktop Toast notifications | | `--foreground` | `false` | Run watcher attached to current process instead of detaching |
--- ## Safety & Responsible Use - **Official API & Account Only**: Uses your own locally authorized `google-colab-cli` OAuth session. Never automates web UIs, never rotates multiple accounts, and **never bypasses CAPTCHAs, rate limits, or quota policies** — any challenge or `401`/`403` triggers an immediate hard stop. - **Zero-Deletion, Zero-Shell Architecture**: All production code uses `{ shell: false, windowsHide: true }`, passes Windows Toast text exclusively via environment variables (zero PowerShell switch injection), persists state via 8-slot atomic renames + kernel `openSync('wx')` cross-process locks, and contains **zero** file-deletion APIs. - **Secret Redaction**: Strips OAuth tokens (`ya29.*`), refresh tokens (`1//*`), Google client secrets (`GOCSPX-*`), Bearer headers, multi-value & RFC 6265 quoted `Cookie`/`Set-Cookie` headers, `X-Goog-Colab-Token`, proxy tokens, and JWTs before writing logs or state. - **Verification**: Run the full hygiene scan and test suite locally: ```bash npm run check # With your local Python binary to include live bridge & detached-daemon E2E suites: COLAB_WATCH_TEST_PYTHON=/path/to/python npm run check ``` ## License [MIT](LICENSE)
latestReleaseNotes:
## ColabWatch v0.1.0

Initial public release of **ColabWatch** — a zero-UI, zero-idle-overhead priority-queue watcher and Antigravity plugin for official `google-colab-cli` runtimes.

### Highlights

- **Silent-Downgrade Shield**: Calls official `colab_cli.client.Client` directly (`COLAB_CLI_ASSIGN_RETRIES=0`), verifies the actual granted accelerator across both `PostAssignmentResponse` and `Assignment` fallback paths, and immediately invokes `unassign()` on mismatch with zero `sessions.json` pollution.
- **Priority-Queue Scheduling**: Ordered GPU/TPU targets (`G4, H100, A100, L4, T4, V6E1, V5E1`) with optional progressive `--hold-top <min>` tier unlocking and automatic skipping of account-ineligible accelerators.
- **Polite Throttling & Circuit Breakers**: Hard `>=15s` base interval floor with `±20%` jitter, `>=300s` HTTP `429` cooldown (`3x` circuit breaker), transient `5xx`/timeout exponential backoff, non-interactive OS keyring auth, and immediate stops on auth expiry, CAPTCHA, low Compute Units balance (`--min-cu`), or active-session conflicts.
- **Mode-A Handover**: Atomically registers acquired sessions into official `sessions.json`, persists state before dispatching non-blocking Windows WinRT Toast alerts (via environment variables — zero CLI switch injection), emits offline browser `connectUrl`, defaults to zero-surprise-kill (`--auto-release-after 0`), and supports opt-in idle auto-release with local-first activity checks.
- **Zero-Daemon Antigravity Plugin**: Pure Skill + CLI bundle (`/colab-watch`), zero `hooks.json`, zero `mcp_config.json`, zero JS runtime dependencies, zero deletion APIs, zero shell execution (`shell: false`), and pure-copy installation with Windows path defenses.

### Verification

- `PUBLIC_SCAN_OK files=28 violations=0`
- `node --test test/colab-watch.test.mjs` — `15/15` passing (`0` skipped)
- Cross-platform GitHub Actions CI (`ubuntu-latest` + `windows-latest` × Node `20/22/24`)
